prompt: In a photorealistic photo of a bustling pottery workshop, the scene captures ten distinct entities engaged in various activities. On the left side of the frame, a woman in a blue apron sits on a wooden stool, her hands covered in wet clay as she shapes a spinning wheel. Next to her stands a tall man in a striped shirt, who is pointing at a specific curve on the emerging vase. In the center foreground, a brown dog lies peacefully on the dusty floor, watching the activity with calm eyes. Beside the dog, a young girl in a yellow dress looks at a stack of finished bowls piled neatly on a low table. To the right, an elderly man with white hair holds a delicate paintbrush, carefully applying glaze to a small cup. Standing next to him is a teenager in a black hoodie, handing a sponge to the older artist. Behind them, a large kiln dominates the back wall, its metal door slightly ajar revealing glowing heat within. A cat with orange fur sleeps atop the warm kiln casing, curled into a tight ball. Near the entrance on the far right, a woman in a green scarf enters the room, carrying a box of supplies. Finally, a child in overalls stands near the center pillar, holding a lump of raw clay tightly. The woman in the blue apron is sitting on the stool. The man in the striped shirt is pointing at the vase. The girl in the yellow dress is looking at the bowls. The teenager in the black hoodie is handing a sponge to the elderly man. There is no electric lighting fixture visible in the ceiling. There is no digital tablet or modern electronic device on any workbench.
